snippet.title: Shift At Midnight - Release Date Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Shift At Midnight: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3722330 

Shift at Midnight is an online co-op detective horror for 1 - 3 players, releasing May 28th 2026! Managing a gas station is tough work – keep your stock shelves full and sell enough products to meet your quota each night, take deliveries and keep your store nice and clean. Oh, and make sure to interrogate each customer as you serve - as some are not human and are in fact doppelgangers – miss one and they will return later that shift to try and kill you. Execute on sight if you think they are not human – just be sure to clean up after. If you mess up, be prepared to set traps, barricade the doors and hide as the doppelgangers return as horrible monsters.

Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative 

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more over on https://iii-initiative.com
